strategies.name: first_5m_opening_range_fvg_retest_scalp
strategies.entry_summary: On the 5-minute chart, mark the high and low of the first 9:30-9:35 candle. On the 1-minute chart, wait for price to break one of those levels with a fair value gap, then wait for price to retest the fair value gap and enter only after the retest candle is engulfed in the breakout direction.
strategies.exit_summary: Place the stop just beyond the deepest point traded into the fair value gap, with one tick of breathing room, and use a fixed 3:1 target. After entry, do not micromanage the trade.

strategies.name: first_15m_opening_range_fvg_limit_reentry_day_trade
strategies.entry_summary: On the 15-minute chart, mark the high and low of the first 9:30-9:45 candle. On the 5-minute chart, wait for price to break one of those levels and form a fair value gap, then place a limit order on the fair value gap so that when price trades back into it, the position is entered automatically.
strategies.exit_summary: Place the stop at/just beyond the first candle of the three-candle fair value gap pattern and use a fixed 2:1 target. After entry, do not micromanage, and tolerate a revisit into the fair value gap without closing early.

result.enumeration_note: The video teaches two distinct but compatible FVG opening-range entries: a 5m/1m retest-plus-engulfing scalp with 3:1 target, and a 15m/5m passive-limit day-trade entry with 2:1 target.
